saw_lines: Parents try one nappy brand, judge it on leaks and rashes, then stay for months.
So the trial or first order offer has to sit in the opening line, since parents decide before reading on.
Your site shows 9,000+ reviews and 100+ awards, yet only 4 of 30 ads carry a proof number. Put 9,000+ reviews on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 28 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 9,000+ reviews and 100+ awards, but only 4 of 30 ads carry a proof number. Without it, a cold buyer has nothing to trust. Put 9,000+ reviews on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 5 off your first order, yet 0 of 16 ads mention it. A first time buyer has no reason to act today. Put the first order offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.
Your 16 copy ads open with 12 different stories, and the biggest opener leads only 2 ads. Each story gets too few ads to build a pattern. Pick the two best stories and build three new ads from each.

24 ads have run 60+ days, which is strong evidence the message works. Keep that structure rather than starting from zero. Build three more variations of the oldest winner, changing only the opening line and image.
